newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares recover to finish firmer.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares recover to finish firmer.

text.p: MILAN, Sept 30 - Italian shares recovered in late Monday afternoon trading from earlier losses led by some major blue chip stocks and helped by the rise in Wall Street, dealers said.

Among the gainers was Olivetti up 6.35 pct at 561.4 lire ahead of planned half year results later today, Parmalat was up 4.08 percent at 2,193 lire head of figures published after the market had closed, while Benetton slide 4.23 percent to 17,067 lire after its first half results.
The all-share Mibtel index ended up 0.21 percent at 10,176 and the blue-chip index 0.15 percent firmer at 15,327.
